source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT 
    ACH_BatchNumber, 
    ACH_TraceNumber, 
    ACH_TransNumber,
    CAST(NEWID() AS VARCHAR(50)) AS External_Id
FROM abhi.sf_test 
WHERE SyncStatus = 'pending'

SELECT 
    External_Id,
    Payload,
    Error_Message,
    CONCAT(External_Id, '-', FORMAT(CreatedAt, 'yyyyMMddHHmmss')) AS Request_Received_At
FROM abhi.ai_appraisal_data
WHERE SyncStatus = 'pending'
